utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just checking—are we still aiming for Saturday morning at the community center, and do you know the exact time yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, Saturday morning still works for me—what exact time are we aiming for at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure of the exact time yet—let me confirm that before I pass it along. Once we know, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can bring my drill and a few extra screws to the community center this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll bring the screwdriver set and work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Dane — that covers it. I’ll see you at the community center this afternoon and we can get the repair drive set up together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, we’re set then — Dane’s bringing the screwdriver set and work gloves, and Eli’s heading to the community center gym this afternoon with gloves and canned goods. I’ll keep coordinating the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so the repair drive is actually locked in now, right? I just want to make sure we’ve got the plan set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it’s locked in now — Dane’s got the screwdriver set and work gloves, and Eli’s heading to the community center gym this afternoon with gloves and canned goods. I’ll keep coordinating the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking the exact time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it. In the meantime, I’m reaching out to folks who can help with tools and repairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just let me know the time when you have it, and I’ll work it around pickup. Thanks for lining up the tools and repairs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll send the time as soon as I confirm it. Thanks for being flexible around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got the repair drive locations noted. We’re starting with the school parking lot after pickup, then the community center tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll keep tracking the supplies list for those stops. Send me the needs list when you have it, and I’ll help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll send over the needs list as soon as I have it. Thanks for helping keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think we said Saturday morning at the community center, but I’m still fuzzy on the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll pass along that it’s Saturday morning at the community center, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — that helps. I’ll wait for the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still figuring out what’s needed, but I’ll head over to the community center gym this afternoon and check the setup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Eli — checking the setup is perfect. If you spot anything missing, let me know and I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it — I’ll bring my wrench set and flashlight and leave them on the porch table. Thanks for pointing out what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are gathering tools and donations over at the community center this afternoon. If you want, I can point you to where they’re setting up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help, thanks — I’m mostly worried about the timing and whether everything’s actually getting logged. If you can point me to the setup, I’ll double-check the list before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — they’re set up inside the community center this afternoon, near the front hall. I’ll point you there so you can check the list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ve got the fence panel and porch light noted. What time are we starting tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re still set for Saturday morning at the community center. I think 9 works best.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 9 works for me — I’ll be there at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — it’s Saturday morning at the community hall, and everyone’s bringing tools and spare parts. I can resend the details, and I’d be glad to help sort the heavier stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara. If you can resend the details, I’ll take a look and see what I can bring for the heavier jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll resend them now, and thank you for helping with the heavier jobs. See you Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still hearing it’s being organized, and I’m waiting on Rosa’s next update. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — keep me posted when Rosa updates you. I’ll keep an ear out too while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center now, and I’m keeping everything organized. If you have any updates or can help with the setup, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rosa — I can help with setup on Sunday and I’ll bring my drill and a few extra screws if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep you posted on the setup details, and we’ll make good use of your drill and extra screws on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I’ve got it all noted, and I’ll keep everyone posted as Sunday gets closer. If you spot any more drop-off spots, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out after pickup and send along any good drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and let everyone know any new drop-off spots for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll help sort what comes in and keep track of the tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll bring the screwdriver set and work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep sorting and tracking the tools when folks drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — if you can point me to the biggest safety fixes first, I’ll turn them into a quick checklist.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — I’d start with loose steps, wobbly handrails, and any exposed wiring first. I’ll double-check the rest once I’m back from my errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect — I’ll make a quick checklist for those first, then we can add the rest when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — bring them by the front table, and I’ll sort the rest for the repair drive. Thanks, Uli!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll drop them off at the front table before Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Uli — the front table works perfectly. I’ll have everything ready for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — once Rosa confirms the date and drop-off spot, I’ll check the donations and we can compare everything before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll wait for Rosa’s confirmation, then we can compare the donations and head over together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — once Rosa confirms it, I’ll double-check the donation list and we can meet up before we go.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring the drill and screws to the community center this afternoon. Just let me know if anything else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s perfect, Leo — I’ve got the community center noted for this afternoon. If anything else comes up, I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll drop them off at the community center this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’d love that, Nell. I’ll put you on the invite list and send along the time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate that. I’ll watch for your message and keep folks posted if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — send me the current needs list, and I’ll keep tracking supplies for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for the current needs list too. Glad to hear things are moving along for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Once the list comes through, I’ll keep tracking supplies and follow up on anything still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what are the top fixes we need to pack for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d start with the bigger repairs first—things like tools, patch kits, tape, and any replacement parts we already know are needed. I can help round up folks who know their way around tools, too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you send me the top fixes so I know what to pack?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll resend the update with the top fixes first so you can pack the right tools and parts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you include the exact time and the community center address too? I want to make sure I’m sharing the right details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll include the exact time and the community hall address in the update too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think we said Saturday morning at the community center, but I’m still fuzzy on the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still hearing it’s at the community center Saturday morning, but I haven’t caught the exact time yet. If you want, I can swing by and see what’s posted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d help a lot—if you can check the posted time, I’d appreciate it.
